office.onlyoffice.title: OnlyOffice Docs
office.onlyoffice.help: Open and edit files of the media library in OnlyOffice Docs. Users who may edit edit there; users who may only download see the file read-only. Changes are saved as a new version.
office.onlyoffice.url_help: Address of the office server, e.g. https://office.example.com. The server must reach the wiki at its public address (server.base_url).
office.onlyoffice.verify_proof: Verify the signature of every request (proof key, recommended)
office.onlyoffice.verify_proof_help: The wiki only accepts requests signed by the office server.
office.onlyoffice.readonly: Users without the right to download may view the file there read-only
office.onlyoffice.readonly_help: Download, print, export and copy are switched off. Otherwise they see the file in the browser only.
office.onlyoffice.test_ok: Connected: {view} file types to view, {edit} to edit
office.onlyoffice.proof_missing: The server publishes no proof key: switch the check off or update the server.
office.onlyoffice.default_hint: Choose the program as default viewer in the general settings (media).
office.onlyoffice.mode_help: The OnlyOffice API works with every version; WOPI must be enabled in the Document Server (wopi.enable).
office.onlyoffice.jwt_secret_help: The same secret as in the Document Server (services.CoAuthoring.secret). Without a secret the API interface is switched off.
office.onlyoffice.jwt_missing: Without a JWT secret the wiki opens no files through the OnlyOffice API.
office.onlyoffice.internal_url_help: When the Document Server offers saved files at an internal address (e.g. http://onlyoffice in the Docker network). The wiki downloads saved files only from the public or this address.
office.onlyoffice.script_failed: The OnlyOffice editor could not be loaded.
